title: ReadValue

url.description: The address the page has now.

source.description: article: the reader's article, as Markdown; snapshot: the snapshot's text in all mode, where the page is not an article.

offset.description: Where this page starts, in characters.

totalChars.description: How long the whole text is, in characters.

nextOffset.description: Where the next page starts; null on the last.

challenge.description: The challenge the page shows, when it shows one.

description: A page of the page's readable text: the article as Markdown, or the snapshot's text; paged by offset.
